name: Mohammed Emad
headline: From the database to the last pixel, I build web apps that just work.
about: I am a software engineer based in Egypt. Most of my work is full-stack web: Laravel and PHP on one side, React and Next.js on the other, with the database, the tests and the deployment in between.

I like the part many people skip. When I take over a codebase I first make it safe to change: pinned dependencies, no secrets in the history, one command that runs every check. Then I fix what is broken, and only then add what is new. Each change gets a test that fails without it, a row in a tracker and a line in the changelog.
This site was built the same way. Its tracker and changelog are part of the repository.
availability: Open to full-time roles and freelance projects. Based in Egypt (Cairo time), working remotely.
